title: Other buildings or structures in Residence Districts
previewText:

blocks.html: (a)        to any commercial use permitted as-of-right within C7 Districts, other than those listed in Use Group V, in which case any subsequent change of use shall conform to the provisions of Section 52-34 (Commercial Uses in Residence Districts); or

blocks.html: provided that such changed use shall conform to all regulations on performance standards applicable in M1 Districts, and that any such changed use, or the storage of materials or products accessory to any changed use, which is not located within a completely enclosed building, shall be screened by a solid wall or fence (including solid entrance or exit gates) at least eight feet in height. Whenever a use located within a completely enclosed building is changed to another use, no activity related to such changed use, including the storage of materials or products, shall be located outside of such building.
